product_overview: Eklavya is a unified scholarship portal that helps students review scholarship status, check eligibility, apply for eligible schemes, verify documents through DigiLocker, and get guidance from an AI assistant. It also provides accessibility and multilingual controls for a more inclusive government-portal experience.
core_goals: Review scholarship sanction and DBT disbursement status
Submit a scholarship application to the institute
Verify documents through DigiLocker consent and OTP flow
Get scholarship guidance from the Ask Eklavya assistant
Adjust accessibility settings and switch the portal language

features.name: Scholarship Dashboard & DBT Tracking
features.description: A student-facing dashboard that shows candidate details, active scholarship information, sanctioned grant totals, and DBT disbursement progress.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View candidate profile and active scholarship summary -> Review sanctioned grant amount and DBT tranche status -> Inspect the disbursement progress stepper -> Open quick navigation links to related sections

features.name: Schemes & Eligibility Verifier
features.description: An eligibility engine that matches the student profile against available scholarship schemes and shows whether each scheme can be applied for.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the Schemes & Eligibility section -> Review verified credentials and income information -> Compare eligible and ineligible scheme cards with rule explanations -> Choose an eligible scheme to continue to application setup
Navigate to / -> Open the Schemes & Eligibility section -> Review scheme requirements -> Select an ineligible scheme -> Observe the eligibility mismatch explanation

features.name: Multi-Step Scholarship Application Form
features.description: A standardized scholarship application form that carries forward the selected scheme, shows progress through the application stages, and lets the student submit the application to the institute.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose an eligible scheme from the scheme list -> Review the prefilled application form -> Confirm or update scheme details -> Save and submit the application to the institute -> See the submission reference generated
Navigate to / -> Open the application form -> Review prefilled candidate details -> Change the target scholarship scheme -> Continue through the application steps -> Submit the completed application

features.name: DigiLocker Document Verification Gateway
features.description: A document verification flow that uses institutional email context, OTP-based consent, and digital certificate fetching through DigiLocker services.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the DigiLocker Services section -> Review the consent notice and registered institutional email -> Enter the security verification OTP -> Authorize document access -> See verified documents linked with green status badges

features.name: Ask Eklavya AI Chatbot
features.description: A conversational assistant that answers scholarship questions using AI and a fallback knowledge base, with the conversation shown in a modal.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the Ask Eklavya assistant -> Type a scholarship-related question -> Receive a structured response with guidance and context -> Close the conversation modal
Navigate to / -> Open the Ask Eklavya assistant -> Ask about DBT payments or eligibility -> Review the AI-generated answer with bullet-point structure

features.name: Accessibility & Multilingual Localization
features.description: Accessibility controls for high contrast and text resizing, plus language switching across supported Indian languages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle high contrast mode -> Observe the interface switch to the alternate contrast theme
Navigate to / -> Use the text resize controls -> Observe the font scale change
Navigate to / -> Open the language selector -> Switch to Hindi, English, Santhali, Gondi, Odia, or Bengali -> Observe the interface language update

routes.description: Eklavya Unified Scholarship Dashboard, Schemes & Eligibility Engine, Multi-Step Application Form, DigiLocker Verification, Profile, and Ask Eklavya AI Assistant

features.name: Scholarship Dashboard & DBT Tracking
features.description: Visual dashboard showing candidate credentials, active Post-Matric OBC scholarship grant (₹ 45,000.00), and Direct Benefit Transfer tranche milestone progress.
user_interactions: View welcome card with candidate name, college, and roll number
Review total sanctioned grant and DBT tranche 1 disbursed status
Inspect 4-stage disbursement progress stepper
Click quick navigation links to Schemes or DigiLocker

features.name: Schemes & Eligibility Verifier
features.description: Dynamic eligibility evaluation engine verifying candidate demographic and academic criteria against Central and State scholarship schemes.
user_interactions: Navigate to Schemes & Eligibility tab
Inspect verified eligibility credentials (OBC, GGCT, Income ₹ 1,80,000.00)
Review eligible and ineligible scheme cards with rule breakdowns
Click Apply for this Scheme on eligible scheme cards to open pre-filled application form

features.name: Multi-Step Scholarship Application Form
features.description: Official NIC-standard 3-step application form with dynamic scheme banner, sans-serif inputs, and institute submission.
user_interactions: Inspect full-width horizontal 3-step progress bar
Review prefilled candidate details (Name, DOB, Roll Number 0208AD231011, Income ₹ 1,80,000.00)
Change or confirm target scholarship scheme dropdown
Click Save & Submit Application to Institute button to generate submission reference

features.name: DigiLocker Document Verification Gateway
features.description: Electronic document verification system with candidate institutional email OTP consent flow.
user_interactions: Navigate to DigiLocker Services tab
Review registered institutional email (anmol.soni@ggct.ac.in) and consent notice
Enter 6-digit security verification OTP
Click Authorize & Fetch Documents to link digital certificates with verified green badges

features.name: Ask Eklavya AI Chatbot
features.description: 24/7 intelligent scholarship assistance powered by Google Gemini API with fallback regulatory knowledge base.
user_interactions: Click floating Ask Eklavya button to open conversation modal
Type question regarding scholarship status, DBT payments, or eligibility
Receive structured AI response with bullet points and candidate context
Close modal using close button

features.name: Accessibility & Multilingual Localization
features.description: GIGW 3.0 and WCAG 2.2 compliant accessibility toolbar supporting high contrast inversion, font resizing, and 6 Indian languages.
user_interactions: Click high-contrast toggle button to switch between light and dark modes
Click font resize buttons (A-, A, A+) to adjust font scale
Open language selection dropdown and switch language to Hindi, English, Santhali, Gondi, Odia, or Bengali
